spec.hypothesis: Origins with at least 96% unchanged days in the last 60 are the flattest hyperscaler spot stretches, mostly A100_40GB spot plus a few fully flat neocloud A100 origins. The medium band is too narrow for the rare jumps. Always-wide beats medium on A100_40GB spot (0.01122 vs 0.01206). The 0.96 cutoff is above the 0.95 cutoff that was not programmable, so it selects a smaller and different set. It leaves the H100 repricing series and the lower-flatness A100_SXM origins alone.
